svg.title: ADL — second floor numbered room layout
svg.desc: Second-floor vector plan using the completed first-floor exterior path unchanged. Room sizes and relative layout are mapped from the supplied second-floor reference. White: numbered rooms. Gray: all unlabeled, mechanical, stair, restroom, open-to-below, and circulation areas. All room walls use the same solid 0.396875 mm line as the exterior. Not a measured architectural plan.

g.inkscape:label: Shared ADL exterior — unchanged from first floor
